newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss set terms on three-month money market claims.
newsitem.headline: Swiss set terms on three-month money market claims.

text.p: The Swiss federal government set terms of three-month money market claims, in a new series 3.352, to be paid for on September 19, the Swiss National Bank said.
The issue totaling 902.30 million Swiss francs was priced at 99.552 percent, to yield 1.78 percent on an annual basis. Bids totaled 1,972.30 million francs.
The previous 6.351 series of six-month claims, paid for on September 12, raised 850.40 million francs and was priced at 99.024 percent to yield 1.95 percent annually.
